ecosystem.title: Your AI ecosystem
ecosystem.body: Start with the providers allowed in your organisation. Only their models will be offered in the use cases below.

configure.title: Provider and model
configure.body: Each use case recalls its provider, model and settings (generated tokens, resolution…). Click this reminder to change them. Example: "Writing a short email" with the Eco model.

frequency.title: Frequency
frequency.body: Enter how often one person does this task, per day, per week or per month. Example: 5 short emails a day. A frequency of 0 is not counted.

impacts.title: Impact per working day
impacts.body: The greenhouse gas emissions and water use of this task, for one working day. Click them to see the five criteria in detail and the data source.

onlyUsed.title: Only my usages
onlyUsed.body: Once your frequencies are entered, tick this box to keep only the use cases you use.

annualTotal.title: Your annual impact
annualTotal.body: The total for one person over a year of 218 working days, with its low and high range. Below: the detail per criterion, telling equivalents and the share of each provider.

headcount.title: At the scale of the organisation
headcount.body: Enter the number of employees concerned to extrapolate the annual impact of the whole organisation.

data.title: Export and import your data
data.body: "Export" saves your inputs and their impacts in a JSON file, per use case, per person and for the company: to keep them or use them in another tool. "Import" reloads this file later: your inputs are restored and the impacts recalculated. The file is created and read by your browser, and never sent to our servers.

reset.title: Start again
reset.body: "Reset" restores the default values. To understand how impacts are calculated, see the Methodology page.
